case.presentation: 58 year old female patient with no significant past medical history presents with a well-defined 6mm ground-glass nodule in the RLL.
case.context: CT obtained for worsening chronic cough, no prior imaging available.

ground_truth.notes: Baseline imaging finding from MacMahon 2017 Figure 9 (single 6mm pure GGN, RLL). Figure shows interval growth over 2 years; v0.1 case uses only the baseline timepoint — prior-comparison reasoning is v0.2 scope. Patient context fabricated; subsolid recommendations are risk-invariant in Fleischner 2017 Table 1B so fabricated risk factors do not affect the ground-truth bin.
